decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. The cloud-sandbox URL now returns the local-sandboxing page, so no cloud lifecycle, policy, data, or audit text was fetched. Billing facts are consistent with the existing record. All gates stay unknown; no human date or gate is renewed.

citations.quote: Cloud sandboxing : Run an entire Copilot session remotely, inside a fully isolated, ephemeral Linux environment hosted by GitHub. Cloud sandboxing is billed based on usage.
When you stop a cloud sandbox, GitHub retains a snapshot of the sandbox's state so you can resume it later.

findings.reason: The fetched page is the local-sandboxing article. It gives no cloud release stage, plan eligibility, or client requirement.
findings.next: Re-fetch the cloud-sandbox article; confirm stage, clients, and plan eligibility.

findings.reason: Only local-sandbox enterprise managed settings were fetched. No org or enterprise policy for cloud sandboxes appears.
findings.next: Find the cloud-sandbox policy; run a negative test with a test identity.

findings.reason: Billing assigns usage to an owner. Token and repository scoping inside a cloud sandbox are not evidenced.
findings.next: Document the identity flow and scopes; test an out-of-scope access attempt.

findings.reason: Snapshots are retained after a stop. Retention limits, deletion, and residency terms are not in the fetched evidence.
findings.next: Review snapshot retention and deletion; test with synthetic data only.

findings.reason: No approval boundary or stop control for cloud sessions is evidenced.
findings.next: Run a prompt-injection test; confirm a human can stop the session.

findings.reason: No audit-log or session-trace evidence for cloud sandboxes was fetched.
findings.next: Capture a sample trace; confirm log access and retention.

findings.reason: Billing meters are documented, but actual allocation, budget, and spend are unmeasured.
findings.next: Measure a synthetic session and set an approved budget.

findings.reason: Network controls for cloud sandboxes were not fetched. Only local proxy and host rules appear.
findings.next: Find cloud egress controls; validate allow and deny in a remote session.

findings.reason: Billing text defines stop, resume, and delete. Owner, failure handling, and preview limits are not evidenced.
